pages:
Welcome to Revival Tech, Cairnfold.
Mind the bells, they're everywhere.

Your team looks wind-bitten.
Want me to rest them?
after_heal: All rested. Warm as a hayloft.

Come back before the next climb.
You will need to.
declined:
Suit yourself. The mountain
won't go easy on tired legs.

pages:
Cold makes the crystals sluggish.
I keep them by the stove.

Head office calls it a fire risk.
I call it Tuesday.

Rope, wool and anything warm.
If it's not warm, we don't stock it.

Please close every gate behind you.
The herd reads signs better than you.

New face! Have a look around.
Prices are on the shelf tags.
